learning_objective: 🎯 Decode the hidden visual meanings behind everyday objects and learn how to create your own powerful symbols in art!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Did you know that a simple drawing can speak a thousand words? A bright red heart instantly means love, and a glowing lightbulb means a brilliant new idea. These magical shortcuts are called symbols!

Indian art is full of beautiful, deeply meaningful objects. A blooming lotus flower stands for pure beauty growing in muddy water, while bright mango leaves at a doorway bring good luck and happiness.
We use icons every single day without even realizing it. The tiny magnifying glass on a computer screen tells us to search, and a red octagon on the street safely tells drivers they must stop.

fun_activity.title: 🛡️ Design Your Personal Logo
fun_activity.instructions: Think of one object or animal that represents your unique personality. Draw it in a very simple, bold, and clean style to create your very own personal icon or superhero logo!

quick_recap: ⭐ Symbols and icons are simple visual shortcuts that communicate huge ideas without using any words.
⭐ Artists carefully choose specific objects in their paintings to hide deep meanings and tell richer stories.
